analysis._note: Descriptive statistics only (eda.py); development period rows only.

splits._note: Proposed by A, to be confirmed by B. Data is NOT physically split; B builds folds from these dates.
splits.cv_scheme: expanding window, one validation year per fold

model._note: All choices pre-declared; see README.md for the protocol.
model.label: y_exret
model.selection_rule: max mean validation OOS R2 (vs expanding train mean)

robustness._note: Sensitivity check: re-run the same CV on dev restricted to date >= min_date (decimalization removed coarse open ticks).

rff._note: Kelly et al. (2024) style exploration: random Fourier features + ridge. Base features = M3.

winsor._note: Label winsorization sensitivity: clip y to [lo, hi] quantiles computed from the train fold only.

partC._note: Part C (member C) trading & evaluation protocol. Frozen on 2026-11-08 before any test-period strategy return was computed; every later change is logged in results/partC/freeze_log.json and README 'revision log'. See docs/protocol_partC.md.

signal.main_is: ridge_M1 (Ridge alpha=10000), fixed by Part B validation

position.risk_proxy: sigma2_daily = vol_rv_20^2 / 252 (close-to-close, known at close t)

rules.cost_aware: w_t = clip( clip(w_{t-1}, (mu_t - c)/(gamma*sigma2_t), (mu_t + c)/(gamma*sigma2_t)), 0, 1 ); single-period optimum of w*mu - gamma/2*w^2*sigma2 - c*|w - w_{t-1}|; w_{t-1} = previous TARGET weight (known at close t); c = cost scenario of the run

costs.unit: fraction of portfolio value per unit of one-way turnover
costs._change_log: 2026-11-09: main cost changed from 5bp (frozen 2026-11-08) to 1bp by member C, after checking that Part A/B set no binding cost (A suggested 1-5bp, decision delegated to C) and external data put SPY quoted bid-ask spread at ~0.3bp (etf.com, S. Roy, 2022-04-27; SSGA est. 0.07bp spread cost). 1bp = ~0.3bp spread + allowance for opening-auction impact. Change made AFTER test results were seen; old 5bp-main outputs archived in results/archive_main5bp/; 5bp kept as sensitivity scenario.

accounting.turnover: drift-adjusted estimate: |w_t - w_drift_{t-1}|, w_drift_{t-1} = w_{t-1}(1+y_ret_{t-1}) / (1 + w_{t-1} y_ret_{t-1} + (1-w_{t-1}) rf_{t-1}); costs deducted from the period return (post-cost cash/SPY holdings not tracked separately; R8). Target-difference |w_t - w_{t-1}| reported as check
accounting.missing_labels: rows without y_ret (last 2 test rows) are dropped, never filled with 0

benchmarks.buy_hold: w = 1 (enter on first day, pays entry cost)
benchmarks.mean_same_rule: historical-mean forecast fed into the same rule (mv and cost_aware)
benchmarks.target_vol: w = min(sigma_target / vol_rv_20, 1); sigma_target = median vol_rv_20 over development rows strictly before the first decision date of the evaluated period (test: 1994-2014 -> 0.1441; validation: 1994-2004 -> 0.1543). Revision R2.
benchmarks.vol_matched_buy_hold: ex-post: buy-hold excess returns scaled by constant to strategy volatility (descriptive only)

events._note: Pre-specified from Part A handoff 6.4 (market events), not from strategy results. Dates are decision dates t.
